name: FFS_FIELD_SET
description: Contains fields and custom properties to be monitored.

columns.name: TYPE
columns.description: Type of monitored record (Activity History monitored fields) and list of fields for Inventory Search.

columns.name: ENTITY
columns.description: Type of monitored record entity the field belongs to (activity, inventory etc.).

columns.name: FIELD
columns.description: Name of a standard field included into this set. Or, the 'property' string is used for the case when it is a custom property.

columns.name: PROPERTY_ID
columns.description: Monitored record reference to custom property identifier.

columns.name: SORTING_ORDER
columns.description: It is an order to be used to sort the corresponding items in GUI.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
